newsitem.title: USA: Mecon says CFO Allinson to resign.
newsitem.headline: Mecon says CFO Allinson to resign.

text.p: Mecon Inc said on Tuesday Chief Financial Officer David Allinson will resign at the end of May to pursue other job opportunities in the private sector.
Mecon said it is seeking replacement for Allinson.

"David has played a key leadership role in the evolution of MECON from a small privately-held company to the diversified publicly-held market leader of today," Les Schmidt, chief executive officer, said in a statement.
To ensure a smooth transition, Schmidt will increase his involvement with the financial team.
